reviews.text: Hi had a cat neutered and she got mastitis after and wound infected a small bit so i left in corrin for a few days sean and the girls were kind and attentive rosie is flying now padraig

I have been using corrin vets for the last 4 years. As my dogs are getting on in age we attend regularly. I also use the kennel facilities. Our dogs do be so happy when they know they going there and they jump with excitment everytime we arrive. We have had vets before and we would have to carry the dogs in. We always know our dogs are in safe hands when we are away. Anytime our dogs were sick we were seem straight away and the dogs were looked after so well. We also used emergency care over Christmas and corrin vets were always at the end of call.
Thanks so much for your help throughout the years and your friendly staff who I love having the chats with. Reggie and buddy would be lost without you!!

Amazing vet!! I rang and got an appointment on the same day which was a Sunday and no other vets were available to help my cat. My cat got his wounds treated, got vaccinated and kept for two nights to get neutered and to recover all for a very fair and reasonable price. I really recommend this vet
Fantastic, compassionate, and great value vets that provide the best care for pets and horses. Highly recommend!

The worst vets practice is a day light robber nearly killed my dog kept her over night when she didn’t need to be gave her drugs she didn’t need the nurses are rude I would never ever again go near this place I will never forgive them what they did to my dog. I wouldn’t trust them as far as I’d throw them the worst vets practice in cork be very aware
Great vets!

Great service on Thursday evening, my dog got heat stroke and was very sick came to the vet , meet Sean ,  he was so gentle and kind, my dog Seedy, was so relaxed with Sean . He told us what to do to get Speedy up and well. Thankfully I can report that Speedy is well again and back to himself. Excellent service and care  frim Sean . Would highly recommend this vet ..
Lost our cat and has done nothing at all to find it

I can’t thank Sean and the team enough for the care they gave my cat Phoebe. She had been vomiting and not eating for 5 days, extremely lethargic and clearly in pain. Sean quickly identified the problem (a piece of wire in her intestine that she somehow swallowed) and performed surgery to remove it. I was so so worried but Sean kept me updated the whole way through and was very reassuring and compassionate.

Phoebe stayed overnight and when I collected her she was purring straight away, not just with me but with Sean and the lovely veterinary student as well. This really showed me how gently and kindly she had been treated while she was there!

When we got home Phoebe immediately started eating and running around again. It’s been a week now and she is perfectly fine again (aside from being unimpressed with her cone😅)

I’m so grateful for the care she received and would highly recommend Corrin Vets to anyone!

Highly recommend, our dog ate an Easter Egg earlier this evening and knowing how dangerous this could be we rang the clinic after 11pm to get advice, the vet said to come to the clinic and he met us at there just before midnight, treated Rufus and was so kind. All is well, and Rufus is now sleeping happily. It is just wonderful to have this service and care out of hours.

Our lovely dog, Woolfie, got sick on St. Patrick's Day, and we visited Corrin Veterinary Clinic. Sean was fantastic and supportive as was the entire team in the office. Thank you also to Andra for helping with filling out the documents for insurance ❤️.
Woolfie is better and getting back to being himself again 🥰.
Very professional and I recommend the place.

Highly recommend! Sean provided a very thorough check-up for Tommy, addressing joint pain and a few infections ( possible kidney infection) based on X-rays and bloodwork. We really appreciate how they looked at everything, because we had been in other clinics and we feel a few things were overlooked. Professional, compassionate, and very high-quality care! Thank you.

I would like to thank most sincerely this practice for the kindness they gave to my beloved pet billy  this morning . I was in a situation this morning where my 5yr old cocker spaniel dog collapsed  and my own vet doesn't do wknd cover . I then rang other vets that was doing cover and luckily for me I rang corrin veterinary practice . I drove 35miles to get my pet looked at . I dealt with a young Spanish vet and what a pure gentleman he was . Unfortunately my dog had to put to sleep due to heart  failure . I'm totally broken . But I have to say the treatment was second to none . Would highly recommend this practice .
Thank you for everything today
Padraic Murray

Our dog Abbey that is nearly 16 years old was sick on a weekend evening, we were immediately able to go to clinic out of hours where Sean cared for her so amazingly, over the following days he explained to us a few issues going on with her and clearly explained how the treatment plan he made will benefit her, abbey has already improved so much in such a short space of time & we are so delighted with the care and knowledge given by the team at Corrin vets, i highly recommend these guys and they have given our beloved Abbey the best care, thank you!

My Dog Abbey (16) has been given the best care by Sean and the crew for the past few weeks. Theyre all loving, helpful and amazing people. Id highly recommend their services. If your animal is sick, you can call them after work hours, if your pet isnt well enough to make it to the clinic they'll arrange a home callout.
Not good

Sean and his assistants have been looking after the health of my horses for the last number of years. They are all extremely knowledgable and experienced. I’ve had two emergencies - the first being a mare with retained placenta and today My stallion sustained a deep gash to his chest area. In both situations the response from Sean and/or his team was immediate. It’s a great peace of mind to have such a professional, caring and trustworthy veterinary practice nearby. Thanks again

I am incredibly grateful for the care and compassion shown by Sean and Olga during such a difficult time. They treated my dog, Cody, with kindness and respect. When it was time to say goodbye, they were gentle and supportive, making the process as peaceful as possible. Sean explained everything clearly and allowed us as much time as we needed. Sean showed genuine empathy, and I truly appreciate his support and professionalism. We are extremely grateful to Sean for allowing us the opportunity to have Cody at home as we said goodbye. I highly recommend their services !!

Updated review: We are very very happy that Tulip is well again after a very serious infection that made her very sick. We took her to Sean and the team and after scans, bloods and 2 rounds of antibiotics Tulip is infection free, I can't thank everyone enough at Corrin Vets for their care and dedication to getting Tulip well again. THANK YOU!!!!

Previous Review: We had our 1 year old Corgi Puppy at Corrin Vet yesterday for a spray. Sean and his team were extremely helpful, phoned me with updates throughout the day and our pupper is home and happy I was very happy dropping her off she was very comfortable and went in with Sean without a backwards glance at me. Highly recommend Corrin Veterinary. Top service.

I don’t have enough words of thanks for Sean. My shihtzu has been with Sean today having been in extreme pain for a couple of days. Leaving your pet with a vet especially when they are poorly is very worrying but Sean’s approach, knowledge & genuine compassion and love for animals is incredible
I really can’t thank you enough
Phone calls of reassurance, regular updates and most importantly seeing my dog calm and happy when I collected him just says in itself how fantastic these guys are
Simply wonderful guy

Recently, my dog Cody was in an accident, and I was panicking because it was a Sunday and nearly impossible to reach local vets. When I contacted Sean, he immediately put my mind at ease and was more than willing to treat Cody. He was extremely thorough, kept me informed throughout, and even let me stay with Cody through the process since he’s still very young. Sean explained all of my options clearly, which was so reassuring. I couldn’t have asked for better care. Cody is now better than every a week later.

We have two Great Danes and two Himalayan kitties we brought over to the states. Nervous, we couldn’t find as good as a vet as we had from New England. After chatting with Sean, we learned his knowledge on our particular breeds was exceptional! He goes above and beyond. We absolutely adore Sean and his team, especially Andra (front desk super woman!!!)! Sean has worked with us after hours when our Dane bloated, he’s assisted us with cat emergencies and boarding is so easy and flexible with timing. We could not be happier with Corrin Veterinary Clinic.

Can highly recommend corrin vets after a recent holiday stay and surgery for our pet dog. Sean, Andrea and all the staff were caring ,helpful and respectful to us and especially our pet(max). A happy dog coming home
Sean fixed our pup when she completely broke both bones in her rear leg , was a complete mess but because of Sean s great work you wouldn't know it, she is perfect again now

From start to finish the care provided for our beautiful little cat to the care provided for us between reassurance and assistance was beyond standard and without the team at Corrin we would have been lost! By far the most pleasant vets we’ve had the pleasure of meeting.

We had to urgently bring our 8 and half year old Rottweiler Willow down last night to the clinic after hours. Sean kindly accommodated us and was there in no time ! The treatment she was given from the minute we arrived was exceptional from …

Unfortunately I had to put my little girl to sleep on Sunday. Was one of the hardest experiences of my life, but the Vet who helped me, Olivia, was so caring and compassionate and made the experience a lot easier for me. She was so patient …

I highly recommend Sean, Andrea and the other lovely girl, he was able to track down a very serious issue and save our little fluff ball. Our cat had repeated vomiting so we attended Sean, he carried out multiple tests and was able to …

Everyone at Corrin Vets is absolutely amazing. They all truly care about every animal that comes in. They’ve looked after my cat Chuck many times and do everything they can to make sure you’re taken care off. Can not recommend them highly enough!!
Excellent care given to our pet mastiff buddy. He loves going to see Sean the vet and Andra at reception.
